description: This file contains Python functions for generating source code (headers, classes, enums, stubs, RPC implementations) based on a JSON schema for a JSON-RPC API. It handles parsing schema, deciding whether to generate code, and writing generated code files, with conditional up-to-date checks.

methods.name: CreateApiHeader(log, source_name, path, headers)
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file declaring the JSON-RPC API, including headers, with logging.

methods.name: Create(log, schema, source_file, path, additional_includes, generate_classes, generate_stubs, generate_rpc)
methods.description: Main function that parses a JSON schema and generates corresponding C++ code files (headers, classes, enums, stubs, RPC implementations) with conditional checks and logging, based on configuration options.

ctags.name: Create
ctags.pattern: /^def Create(log, schema, source_file, path, additional_includes, generate_classes, generate_stubs/
ctags.signature: (log, schema, source_file, path, additional_includes, generate_classes, generate_stubs, generate_rpc)
